svg.title: MediaLog: an 8-bit demo screen
svg.desc: MediaLog in fat wide-pixel chrome letters, one kind colour per letter, over a starry sky. Below: Everything you've watched, read, played, listened to, on one timeline, the verb changing every four seconds while four players act it out on the grass. Underground, the log five years at a time as coloured layers of sediment, entries buried in them as fossils in their kind's colour, the newest layer still settling and one film, sometime in 2015-2019, drifting up and down its layer. At the bottom, a feed of what friends have been into.
